what: a loft cut through a 100 x 60 x 30 block from its whole 100 x 60 outline at z = 20 (edges flush with the side faces) down to a 10 x 10 pad in a corner at z = 11, sections given top first (the cut panicked for one order)
method: the loft is a ruled prismatoid between the 100 x 60 rectangle at z = 20 and the 10 x 10 square at z = 11 (corner at (2,2)..(12,12)): V = h/6 (A0 + 4 Am + A1) with h = 9, Am = (110/2) (70/2): V_loft = 20700.0. The top section covers the whole cross-section at z = 20, so the 10 mm slab above it is cut loose from the rest: two bodies, together 180000 - V_loft; the result must not depend on the order of the sections.
